title: Turkey Turns Hagia Sophia Back into a Mosque
dek: On 10 July 2020 a Turkish court voided the museum status and Erdogan ordered the former Byzantine cathedral reopened as a mosque.

panels.label: Ankara and Diyanet Framed
panels.text: Ankara and the Presidency of Religious Affairs framed the reopening as lawful sovereign control and as continuity with the building's Ottoman use as a mosque.

panels.label: UNESCO and Critics Framed
panels.text: UNESCO, Orthodox churches, and secular critics framed the reopening as a break with shared heritage and with the 1934 museum settlement.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Both sides framed a claim to the same building. At stake is who controls Hagia Sophia: the Turkish state, or the 1934 museum settlement held as shared heritage.
